reviews.title: Reading the News on the litter box
reviews.text:
This is a great way of upcycling newspapers, cardboard and paper products.

Tip: Use a two tray litter box. Place a layer of litter on the bottom of the bottom tray about 4cm deep.
Sprinkle baking soda over the top to absorb odours.
Place the second mesh tray on top and add another layer of cat litter about 4-5cm deep.
Sprinkle baking soda over the top to absorb odours.

Pro Tip: Check every three days. Scoop up wet clumped litter in both upper and lower trays. Use the non wet relative clean litter from the top tray to fill the bottom tray.
Now just top up the top mesh tray.

This will save you money.
